$comment: What snapshot validation accepts and rejects in the first half of slice 3 (rows M19, M20; the integrating cases of M09). Derived from F §4.1 (role contracts) with E2 ('prohibitions are enforced twice'; 'rejected whole; there is no partial acceptance'), D1 §§5.1, 5.2, 7.3, 7.8, RN R2, and build spec §6 correction 15 (Review B05: for the run's own workspace, file content is judged by the captured diff; its HEAD, index, git metadata and identity file stay invariant). Where those sources leave a path rule or a reason class open, the choice is recorded in SEAM.md §36. Tests generate their cases from this file; they never ask the engine what a role may write.

reason_class.$comment: One rule decides the class (SEAM.md §28). A violation found in the captured diff, that is in what the snapshot tree holds against its base (a path, a symbolic link, an entry's kind, a size, a count), is `diff_violation`. A violation found outside the diff (a registered ref, the workspace's HEAD or index, git metadata, another managed checkout) is `ref_violation`. D1-10 gives `diff_violation` for an escaping link; D1 §7.3 step 4 gives `ref_violation` for a ref or checkout the role altered.

builder.rule: May change any path that is not under `.surety/`. Everything under `.surety/` belongs to another role or to the engine: the protected set (`.surety/checks/`), the policy file, the project identity file, and the Spec Writer's and Architect's artifacts.

architect.rule: May change only paths under `.surety/adrs/`, `.surety/architecture/`, `.surety/roadmap/` and `.surety/phases/` (D1 §5.1). It writes no code, no checks and no specification.
architect.$permitted_comment: No example under `.surety/phases/`: what a committed phase plan must contain, and what its finalizer registers, is row M26's (the second slice-3 session).

$not_yet: What validation does with the diff of a `verification` or `review` run is pinned in slice 5 with proposal capture (row M36). Until then the slice-2 cases in which a verification role writes a file and completes stand (COVERAGE.md).

metadata.$comment: Row M19: alterations outside the diff, each made by a Builder that also makes a permitted edit. Every one rejects the whole result with `ref_violation`: nothing is committed, the permitted edit included.

cases.what: commits in its workspace, so that the detached HEAD is no longer at the base
checks out a new branch in its workspace, so that HEAD is no longer detached
stages a file in the workspace's real index
writes a hook into the repository's hooks directory
edits a tracked file in another run's retained workspace

diff.$comment: Row M20: what a snapshot may not hold. Every one rejects the whole result with `diff_violation`.

cases.what: a symbolic link to an absolute path outside the workspace
a symbolic link that climbs out of the workspace with `..`
a symbolic link to a symbolic link that leads outside the workspace
a tracked file replaced by a symbolic link that leads outside the workspace
a git repository of its own inside the workspace, which a snapshot would hold as a gitlink
a source change together with a change under the protected root
more bytes than snapshot_max_bytes, in files each within snapshot_max_file_bytes

literal_names.$comment: Row M20, 'prompt remains data': file names a Builder may give its files. Each is committed under exactly that name; none is interpreted by a shell or taken for an option.
